description: Source code for RemotePlugin class implementing a remote plugin interface with socket communication, process management, and JSON-RPC handling in a C++ project.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: Implements a remote plugin with socket communication, process control, and JSON-RPC message handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the remote plugin, opens socket, and optionally spawns remote process.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops socket, and waits for remote process to close.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends JSON message to a specified channel.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC invocation, sends invoke message over socket.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel and sends attach message.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel and sends detach message.

methods.name: onRead
methods.description: Callback for processing responses read from socket.

methods.name: LaunchRemoteProcess
methods.description: Forks and executes remote process with specified shared library, IP, and port.
